title: EmptyState
summary: EmptyState gains an optional size='sm' for cards, side panels and table bodies: 48px icon tile, 16px title, 14px description and 16px padding. The default is byte-for-byte unchanged.
why: Untitled UI, Mantine and HeroUI offer a compact empty state because the full 90px-icon / 24px-title view overwhelms a table body, a small card or a panel.
A small variant keeps product teams from overriding sizes with className hacks.
states: Empty state / default: padding 24, gap 20, icon tile 90x90, title 24/32 semibold, description 16.
Empty state / small: NEW. padding 16, gap 16, icon tile 48x48, icon 24x24, title 16/24 semibold, description 14/20 regular.
figmaSteps: Add a 'size' property to EmptyState: default | sm. Default is unchanged.

Small: auto-layout vertical, centred, padding 16 on all sides, gap 16. Icon tile: 48x48 circle (radius 60), fill #FFFFFF, 1px stroke #E9EAEB, same inner shadow as default (0 1 2 rgba(12,15,18,0.05), inset 0 0 0 1 rgba(10,13,18,0.18), inset 0 -2 0 rgba(12,15,18,0.05)). Icon inside: 24x24, colour #5E5E5E (default size uses 40x40 in the 90px tile).
Small text group: gap 6; title Inter 16 / line height 24, weight 600, #484848; description Inter 14 / line height 20, regular, #5E5E5E. Action row: gap 12 (unchanged).
Default stays: padding 24, gap 20, tile 90x90, title 24/32 600, description 16 normal line height.
notes: In size='sm' the icon inside the tile is sized to 24px by the component ([&>svg]:size-6), so an icon passed with its own 40px class still fits the 48px tile. Description size 14px and gap 16px were my choice (the brief gave tile, title and padding only): please confirm with design.
Default output was verified identical: the default root/tile/title/description class strings are literals, and a test asserts omitted size and size='default' render the same HTML.
Research conclusions in 'why' come from the task brief; I did not re-verify them against each library.
